I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL database backend:

1. Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kvmo5mni/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kvmo5mni/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to pass `'database'` and `'password'` instead of the deprecated `'db'` and `'passwd'` keyword arguments.
2. Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kvmo5mni/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L60) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kvmo5mni/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check `'database'` in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `'db'` and `settings_dict['NAME']`).
